Welcome to CarWashKing.com!


Buying a Car Wash should be a fun and exciting experience. Along with the opportunity to create another stream of revenue, comes the possibility of aggravation, mistakes and financial loss. Sure you can learn from your mistakes, but some mistakes can be very costly, or may even ruin your business.

We are here to help you eliminate those mistakes before they happen, while passing along techniques that work. Not only do we have our own personal experiences as owners and operators to draw from, but we have seen both the errors and successes of hundreds of our clients as well.

Our real estate and finance backgrounds can get you to the closing table, but we want more than to simply help you buy or sell a wash. We want you to succeed! It is this desire, along with our industry insight, that sets us apart from our competition. We have surrounded ourselves with the most knowledgeable and successful people in the car wash industry. Let us put our experience to work for you today.

In addition to our Brokerage services we offer consulting services relating to all aspects of the Car Wash Industry. We have a vast knowledge of car washing and are learning every day through our experiences in selling and consulting for our thousands of new and existing clients.
